combo_label: At the Cinema × Baking & Cakes × Shakespeare

entries.clue: Sprouted grain, kilned and sweet, behind a sticky dark fruit loaf
Fiery Capulet cousin, dubbed 'prince of cats', cut down in a street duel
Shabby little picture house, affectionately insulted
Savoury crystal added by the pinch, without which a loaf tastes flat
Jam-spread cake curled into a spiral log and cut into rounds
Big-screen brand whose curved displays tower several storeys high
Torch-carrying attendant who guides latecomers to their row
Plush tip-up perch you claim with a draped coat
Warwickshire river whose name simply meant 'river' in old Brythonic
What a knife takes off a loaf in one flat cut, ready for the toaster
Direction in Latin, 'they go out', that clears several characters at once
Big British cinema chain whose name reputedly salutes founder Oscar Deutsch
Island-born brute who curses the magician that enslaved him
